items.html:
No correctness blocker found.

  • Memory/performance concern: fields.rs:592 retains every centre’s complete harmonic table until that sample finishes. Each Solid is 208 bytes, including unused Hessians during value-only evaluation. At 1,000 centres and lmax=20, this adds ~87.5 MiB per sample, or ~2.73 GiB for 32 concurrent samples. Consider last-centre caches or measure/document this tradeoff before claiming broad cluster-field acceleration.
  • Hessian recurrence is consistent: harmonics.rs:214, 248, and 287 preserve the scalar operation order, previous recurrence values, and negative-order reflection.
  • Cache keys and sparse dispatch are sound: wavenumber belongs in the key because argument scaling depends on it. Each cache serves one point and derivative level. Validated degrees stop at 128, and deduplication bounds the work sum, so dispatch arithmetic cannot overflow.
  • Existing Rust field_evaluation_contract generates lmax=3, which activates the table path and covers physical identities and finite-difference pullbacks. The new exact scalar comparisons add substantially stronger table-specific coverage.

Read-only review only; no builds, tests, timings, or edits performed.

No remaining blocking findings.

The two cache slots now bound per-sample harmonic storage independently of centre count. Eviction checks the centre, each slot implicitly identifies its wavenumber, and typed caches preserve derivative level. The contiguous-run requirement prevents repeated table filling for interleaved bases; the updated regression exercises that fallback.

One residual optimization opportunity: WaveSet::harmonic_tables still duplicates identical reflection tables across centres. At 1,000 centres and lmax=20, that is ~3.4 MiB of persistent metadata, so much smaller than the resolved scratch-memory issue and not worth complicating this patch without measurements.

No blocking findings in the outgoing radial batching.

  • fields.rs:458: sorted, deduplicated labels make each range independent of mode order and specific to its centre/wavenumber. Empty groups remain disabled.
  • fields.rs:595: the sequence includes exactly the required maximum degree plus one or two. Cache bounds accommodate both; the first requested degree reliably marks initialization.
  • fields.rs:603: zero, underflowed, and nonfinite arguments retain scalar checks. For valid singular arguments, normalized radius lies in [1, √3], so dividing by its degree power introduces no new overflow.
  • Packed harmonic storage correctly maps values, gradients, and Hessians. The shortened origin-series tail bound is consistent with its recurrence.

The new high-order contract test appropriately covers permutation invariance, reference agreement, physical identities, and pullbacks without weakening tolerances. The batching changes rounding versus scalar evaluations; the isolated exact harmonic test and tolerant complete-contract test distinguish those concerns correctly.

Read-only review; no builds, timings, tests, or edits.
